scheme_name: Himachal Pradesh Maharishi Valmiki Sampoorn Swachata Puraskar (state Sanitation Reward Scheme)
other_conditions: The Gram Panchayat must be open defecation‑free (ODF).
Gram Panchayats that have won at a particular level are ineligible to compete at the same level for the next three years, but may compete at higher levels.
The state‑level winner is ineligible to participate in the MVSSP competition for three years after winning.
benefits_summary: Cash prize ranging from ₹1 lakh at block level to ₹10 lakh at state level for the winning Gram Panchayat.
documents_required: Application form attested by the Gram Panchayat head and three other members
